[ASSISTANT_SAID] The University of Maryland promotes a culture of collaboration and respect among researchers from different departments and disciplines.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Interdisciplinary research is promoted as a complementary approach that leverages strengths of various disciplines to address complex problems.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Researchers are encouraged to maintain expertise in their respective areas while collaborating with others.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The university employs a peer review process to ensure interdisciplinary research meets rigorous standards of academic excellence.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Research proposals undergo multiple rounds of review, including experts from various disciplines, to ensure each discipline's perspectives are considered.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The university provides interdisciplinary training programs that equip researchers with a common language and understanding of different research methods.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Researchers are trained to communicate effectively across disciplines while maintaining deep expertise in their own discipline.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The university encourages researchers to publish findings in top-tier journals across multiple disciplines to enhance quality and maintain depth of knowledge.
